notes: The Sale column now adds itself up, right underneath itself. Beverage Control’s bottom strip loses “Avg Variance %” (its figure moved into the Total Variance tooltip) and gains “Total Sale” — the Sale column’s own sum in millilitres and pieces, the very figures the Tally Sheet’s Grand Total prints. Its label carries the answer, “✔ Tally Sheet agrees” or “⚠ N brands differ”, and one click opens the two totals side by side.
